one_line_description: Freshdesk offers AI-powered customer service with a REST API and MCP server for integrating with AI agents.
auth_notes: API key-based authentication is used for accessing the API and MCP server.
gate_detail: A 14-day free trial is available for new accounts.
api_access_pricing: free with trial, pay-as-you-go for higher usage

evidence.quote_snippet: Freshdesk brings ready-to-use AI, people, and workflows together, with a guided path to AI adoption, so service improves from day one and becomes increasingly AI-powered over time.
Freshdesk offers flexible pricing plans designed to scale with your business as it grows.
